name: Chiang Mai
summary: Explore the walled old town on foot and reserve a separate excursion for Doi Suthep or Doi Inthanon. The city rewards a slower pace and northern Thai food rather than constant long day trips.
seasonNote: Late dry-season smoke can substantially reduce air quality; check current conditions before a February–April visit. Mountain mornings can be cool.
arrival: The airport is close to the city; use an official taxi or pre-agreed transfer.
gettingAround: Walk temple clusters; use songthaews or app-booked cars for longer hops. Mountain trips need planned transport.
cashTip: Cash is useful at markets and smaller restaurants; agree shared-truck fares before boarding.
foodTip: Try khao soi, northern sausages and nam prik; ask about meat, shrimp paste and chilli.
buyTip: Choose textiles, ceramics and silver from makers who can explain materials and provenance.
baseArea: Old City for walking or Nimman for cafés.
